items.title: Jerry Bergonzi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 7, 2022
items.q: September 2 and September 4 I’m playing with the Elvin Jones 50th Anniversary of Live at the Lighthouse with Dave Liebman, Gene Perla, Adam Nussbaum.

ctx.x: No, I’ve got a gig in Brooklyn Thursday but then I’m coming — I have to go to St. John’s Island, I’ve got a gig up there with Jim Vivian, a great bass player. He got a grant to have me just come up there and do a concert. And then I’m going to Europe to Denmark for two and a half weeks, mostly Denmark. I’m going to Berlin for a couple of days. Then I come home and go to Montreal to do a recording with Remi Bolduc, a great

alto player who teaches at McGill, doing a jazz camp in August, Jazz in the Mountains in Vermont, and September — oh June 30 also September 2 and September 4 I’m playing with the Elvin Jones 50th Anniversary of Live at the Lighthouse with Dave Liebman, Gene Perla, Adam Nussbaum. We’re playing those tunes from that album.
